Biwin Storage Technology.why: Sells enterprise SSDs and server memory modules (PCIe / SATA SSD, RDIMM, CXL DRAM) for data centers and AI infrastructure built on NAND/DRAM wafers it buys under LTAs, with in-house packaging; its stock benefits directly from NAND storage demand.
Biwin Storage Technology.evidence: Biwin Storage Technology IR activity record (09-09-2026): PC and enterprise storage revenue RMB 29.47 hundred million in H1 2026; LTAs with memory wafer makers totalling US$33.608 hundred million.

players.product: Enterprise PCIe and SATA SSDs, RDIMM and CXL DRAM modules for servers, with in-house memory packaging and test (Huizhou) and wafer-level advanced packaging (Dongguan)

quarterly_data.quarter: Biwin Storage Technology IR activity record: 2026-09-09 (09-09-2026)

quarterly_data.quarter: Biwin Storage Technology IR activity record: 2026-09-09 (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): inventory reached RMB 181.68 hundred million at H1 2026, up 130.89% from end-2025, from strategic stocking; the company keeps signing LTAs with major memory wafer makers to lock wafer capacity and disclosed two long-term raw-material purchase agreements with memory makers in March and June 2026 with cumulative committed purchases of US$33.608 hundred million, locking core material supply for the next two years. Management: this round of memory price rises is driven by the AI compute demand boom.
quarterly_data.figure: inventory RMB 181.68 hundred million (+130.89%); LTAs US$33.608 hundred million

quarterly_data.quarter: Biwin Storage Technology IR activity record: 2026-09-09 (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): two production bases - Tailai Technology in Huizhou (memory and SiP packaging and test, 16/32-die stacking, 30-40 micron ultra-thin die, mainly serving the parent with some capacity for strategic customers) and the Dongguan wafer-level advanced packaging base (Guangdong Xincheng Hanqi) covering 2.5D, RDL, Fan-in and Fan-out.

quarterly_data.quarter: Biwin Storage Technology IR activity record: 2026-09-09 (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): the Dongguan wafer-level packaging project plans 5,000 wafers/month by end-2026 and 10,000 wafers/month by end-2027 and, if customer adoption goes smoothly, should contribute revenue from end-2026. Products: FOMS-R ultra-thin LPDDR has received customer demand forecasts; CMC compute-in-memory chiplet product integrates 10 chiplets with process samples done; OEC co-packaged optics - co-developing 6.4T NPO optical-engine packaging with a customer, R&D expected complete in Q4 2026.
